# Implementation Plan: BNP (Bike Number Plate) Full-Stack E-Commerce & Admin Platform

A high-performance, sensory-designed, full-stack e-commerce web application and administration portal for **BNP: Bike Number Plate** (*A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture*), accessible at `bnp.shop` and backed by cPanel MySQL and the LoraHost Payment Bridge.

---

## Goal Description

Build and deploy a complete, production-grade e-commerce application for **BNP: Bike Number Plate** ([bnp.shop](https://bnp.shop)), offering custom laser-cut mirror-silver steel and BRTA-compliant aluminum motorcycle and scooter plates in Bangladesh. 

The project delivers:
1. **Award-Winning Sensory One-Page Storefront**: Implemented following the Biological UI / Sensory tactile philosophy, featuring a live interactive metallic plate designer, English-to-Bangla real-time smart transliteration, BRTA compliance urgency counter, retail and wholesale dealer pricing tiers, streamlined order intake with mandatory WhatsApp registration-paper verification, and dual payment rails (automatic LoraHost Payment Bridge relay + manual bKash/Nagad fallback).
2. **Robust Backend & Database**: Powered by Next.js 14+ App Router API routes, cPanel MySQL with parameterized queries, server-side pricing recalculation, cryptographic HMAC return verification, and raw-body webhook signature validation.
3. **Automated Discord Dispatcher**: Server-side dispatch of rich embeds on verified transactions to notify the operations team instantly.
4. **Custom Administrative Portal (`/admin/*`)**: Secure bcrypt-authenticated management dashboard for searching, filtering, and updating order statuses (New, Confirmed, Printed, Shipped, Delivered) with direct WhatsApp customer chat links, alongside a live store settings configurator.
5. **Strict Git & Milestone Discipline**: Every phase delivered as a distinct commit, pushed to GitHub ([Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP)), and opened as an isolated pull request with **strictly zero AI attribution**, no skip-CI markers, and zero policy drift.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Client ["Client Browser (Mobile-First / Facebook Traffic)"]
        UI["Urgency Bar & Hero"]
        PD["Plate Designer (Model A / B)"]
        Bangla["lib/bengali.ts (English -> Bangla)"]
        Order["Order Form (Pathao Courier + Bracket)"]
        WA_Notice["WhatsApp Reg-Paper Notice"]
    end

    subgraph Server ["Next.js 14+ App Router (Vercel / Node)"]
        API_Order["POST /api/order"]
        API_Return["GET /payment/return (HMAC Check)"]
        API_Webhook["POST /api/payment/webhook (X-Signature Check)"]
        Discord["Discord Webhook Relay"]
        Admin_Auth["/api/admin/auth (JWT Cookie)"]
        Admin_API["/api/admin/orders & settings"]
    end

    subgraph Database ["HostNF cPanel MySQL (HostNF Hosting)"]
        DB_Orders[("orders table")]
        DB_Settings[("settings table")]
        DB_Admins[("admins table")]
    end

    subgraph External ["External Services & Partners"]
        LoraHost["LoraHost Payment Bridge (PayStation: bKash, Nagad, Cards)"]
        Discord_Channel["Discord Private Admin Channel"]
        WhatsApp_Shop["WhatsApp Verification (01914-873925)"]
    end

    UI --> PD
    PD <--> Bangla
    PD --> Order
    Order --> WA_Notice
    Order -->|1. Submit Order| API_Order
    API_Order -->|Validate & Insert pending_payment| DB_Orders
    API_Order -->|Read Pricing & Config| DB_Settings
    API_Order -->|2. Create Session (Bearer Token)| LoraHost
    LoraHost -->|Return checkout_url| API_Order
    API_Order -->|Redirect Customer| LoraHost
    LoraHost -->|3. Browser Return (sig)| API_Return
    API_Return -->|Verify Return HMAC & Update Order| DB_Orders
    LoraHost -->|4. Async Signed Webhook (X-Signature)| API_Webhook
    API_Webhook -->|Raw HMAC Verify & Mark Paid| DB_Orders
    API_Webhook -->|5. Instant Sale Alert Embed| Discord
    Discord --> Discord_Channel
    Admin_Auth <--> DB_Admins
    Admin_API <--> DB_Orders & DB_Settings
```

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Database Architecture (cPanel MySQL)**:
> In strict accordance with the project specification, this project connects directly to **cPanel MySQL** (`hostnf` hosting) via `mysql2/promise` with parameterized queries. No BaaS (Supabase, Firebase) is used for database storage. Please confirm that your cPanel MySQL host allows remote connections from Vercel (or whether this project will be deployed as a standalone Node.js app within cPanel Passenger).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **LoraHost Payment Bridge Credentials**:
> Session creation, return validation, and webhook verification require the following environment variables:
> - `LORA_BRIDGE_URL` (`https://lorahost.lorapok.tech`)
> - `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN` (Bearer client token for partner `bnp`)
> - `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN` (HMAC secret for return URL query string)
> - `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN` (HMAC secret for raw-body `X-LoraHost-Signature`)
> When deploying to production, these must be configured in your environment; mock/fallback modes will be provided for local testing without breaking the build.

> [!WARNING]
> **Strict No-AI-Attribution Version Control Policy**:
> All commits, branches, PR titles, PR descriptions, and code files will strictly omit any Claude Code, Antigravity, or AI tags, trailers (`Co-Authored-By`), or badges.

---

## Open Questions

> [!NOTE]
> 1. **Delivery Zone Structure**: The base delivery fee in the sample invoice is `60 BDT` (inside Dhaka). For outside Dhaka (nationwide Pathao courier), should we offer a toggle (e.g. Inside Dhaka `60 BDT` / Outside Dhaka `120 BDT`), or a single flat passed-through rate configured in `settings`? (Recommended: 2-tier toggle Inside Dhaka 60 / Outside Dhaka 120, fully editable via `/admin/settings`).
> 2. **Initial Admin Credentials**: To seed the `admins` table upon initial migration, what default admin email should be created (e.g. `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com` or `admin@bnp.shop`)? We will provide a secure CLI seeding script (`npm run seed:admin`) that bcrypt-hashes a password interactively or from env.

---

## Proposed Changes

The implementation will be executed across 7 modular, independently verifiable milestones. Each milestone will result in a clean commit and separate PR pushed to [Maijied/BNP](https://github.com/Maijied/BNP).

---

### Milestone 1: Foundation, Design System & App Shell

Scaffold the Next.js 14+ project, configure typography, install design tokens, establish the full carbon-black and mirror-silver luxury theme, and lay out component shells.

#### [NEW] `package.json`
- Next.js 14+ (App Router), React 18/19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`, `mysql2`, `bcryptjs`, `jose`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`.
- Scripts: `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`, `db:migrate`, `seed:admin`.

#### [NEW] `tailwind.config.ts`
- Custom palette:
  - Carbon Black: `#0B0B0C`, `#121214`, `#18191D`, `#222329`
  - BNP Crimson Red: `#E11D2E`, `#EF233C`
  - Mirror Silver gradients: `#F8FAFC`, `#E2E8F0`, `#94A3B8`, `#475569`
  - Gold Micro-highlights: `#D4AF37`, `#F59E0B`
- Glassmorphism backdrops, metallic text shadows, and embossed plate drop shadows.

#### [NEW] `app/layout.tsx`
- Load **Hind Siliguri** (Bangla charset + numerals) and **Sora** / **Space Grotesk** via `next/font/google`.
- SEO Metadata: OpenGraph, Twitter cards, Apple Touch Icons, Title: *"BNP | Bike Number Plate — Premium Quality Mirror Silver Steel Plates"*.

#### [NEW] `.env.example`
- Template containing all required environment variables:
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`, `MYSQL_HOST`, `MYSQL_PORT`, `MYSQL_USER`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_DATABASE`, `LORA_BRIDGE_URL`, `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN`, `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN`, `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`, `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`, `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`, `ADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL`.

#### [NEW] `.gitignore`
- Exclude `node_modules`, `.next`, `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.*.local`, `.DS_Store`, and temporary test files.

---

### Milestone 2: Bengali Transliteration & Live Plate Designer

Build the centerpiece feature: a realistic, sensory-tactile interactive plate designer with real-time English-to-Bangla auto-conversion.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UserInput["User types: 'Dhaka Metro LA 12 3456'"]
    Lexer["English-to-Bangla Transliteration Engine (lib/bengali.ts)"]
    Parsed["Region: ঢাকা মেট্রো | Serial: ল | Part 1: ১২ | Part 2: ৩৪৫৬"]
    Preview["Live Plate Canvas / CSS Shader (Model A: 285x50 / Model B: 200x100)"]

    UserInput --> Lexer
    Lexer --> Parsed
    Parsed --> Preview
```

#### [NEW] `lib/bengali.ts`
- Transliteration dictionary for all 64 Bangladesh districts & metropolitan zones:
  - `Dhaka Metro` / `DM` -> `ঢাকা মেট্রো`
  - `Chattogram Metro` / `CTG` -> `চট্টগ্রাম মেট্রো`
  - `Cumilla` -> `কুমিল্লা`, `Sylhet` -> `সিলেট`, `Rajshahi` -> `রাজশাহী`, `Khulna` -> `খুলনা`, `Barishal` -> `বরিশাল`, `Rangpur` -> `রংপুর`, `Mymensingh` -> `ময়মনসিংহ`.
- Vehicle class letters mapping:
  - `HA` / `H` -> `হ`
  - `LA` / `L` -> `ল`
  - `GA` / `G` -> `গ`
  - `KHA` -> `খ`, `GHA` -> `ঘ`, `CHA` -> `চ`, `DA` -> `ড`, etc.
- Digits conversion: `0-9` to `০-৯`.
- Dual-mode support: Seamlessly handles direct Bangla keyboard typing as well as auto-translating English input.

#### [NEW] `components/PlateDesigner.tsx`
- Aspect ratio toggles:
  - **Model A (Motorcycle)**: 285 x 50 mm ratio (5.7 : 1), single-line stamped layout.
  - **Model B (Scooter)**: 200 x 100 mm ratio (2 : 1), two-line stamped layout.
- Photorealistic metallic shader:
  - Multi-stop linear silver/chrome gradient with specular highlight sweep.
  - Embossed stamped text effect with dual shadows (inset highlight top-left, dark drop shadow bottom-right).
  - BRTA standard mounting holes (2 x 12 x 5.5 mm slots) rendered at exact scale.
  - Animated number stamp-in micro-interaction via Framer Motion.
- Technical specs overlay: 0.8 mm Mirror Silver Steel, Finish No. 8, Laser Edge, BRTA Front Plate Compatible.

---

### Milestone 3: Storefront Sections & Order Intake Experience

Assemble the full one-page storefront in the exact sequence specified by the design architecture.

#### [NEW] `components/UrgencyBar.tsx`
- Top notification banner: *"BRTA deadline: November 15 — order your compliant plate today"* + Hotline click-to-call: `01632333221`.
- Dynamic fallback to `settings` table with local default.

#### [NEW] `components/Navbar.tsx`
- Brand mark: BNP | Bike Number Plate, *"A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture"*.
- Navigation anchors: Designer, Pricing, Wholesale, Order, Hotline.

#### [NEW] `components/Hero.tsx`
- Cinematic hero with 3D-styled metallic plate render, metallic badges (*0.8mm Stainless Steel*, *Finish No. 8*, *Laser Cut*), tagline *"Premium Quality | Durable | Stylish"*, and CTA button leading directly to the designer.

#### [NEW] `components/Pricing.tsx`
- Retail Cards:
  - Model A (Motorcycle 285x50 mm): **380 BDT** (Pre-order: **300 BDT**).
  - Model B (Scooter 200x100 mm): **450 BDT** (Pre-order: **380 BDT**).
  - Mounting Kit Addon: **+80 BDT** (Clamp bracket + high-tensile bolts & washers).
- B2B Wholesale Tier Matrix (Dealer rates from 65 BDT/pc at 400 pcs up to 80 BDT/pc) with direct WhatsApp order button for bulk inquiries.

#### [NEW] `components/OrderForm.tsx`
- Synchronized with the Plate Designer.
- Form inputs: Customer Name, Shop Name (optional), Mobile Number (validation: `^01[3-9]\d{8}$`), Delivery District (64 districts dropdown), Detailed Street Address, Plate Model selection, Plate Number, Quantity, Bracket Addon (checkbox).
- Live pricing calculator (display only; verified server-side).
- **Mandatory WhatsApp Registration Notice Box**:
  - High-visibility amber/red card: *"⚠️ BRTA Verification Requirement: After placing your order, send a clear photo of your bike registration card/paper via WhatsApp to 01914-873925. Plates are manufactured strictly matching your legal paper."*

#### [NEW] `components/PaymentSection.tsx`
- Full advance payment policy notice (strictly no COD).
- Primary: **LoraHost Payment Bridge** (PayStation: bKash, Nagad, Visa, Mastercard, AMEX).
- Fallback Accordion: Manual bKash/Nagad Personal Send Money to `01632333221` with fields for Sender Number & Transaction ID.

#### [NEW] `components/FAQ.tsx`
- 6 key customer questions: Legal compliance with BRTA rules, delivery timelines (Pathao 24-48h Dhaka / 48-72h outside), plate durability & rust resistance, mounting bracket installation, payment security.

#### [NEW] `components/Footer.tsx`
- Brand attribution: *"A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture"* (Founders: Joy & Arash).
- Hotline: `01632333221` | WhatsApp: `01914-873925` | Email: `bikesnumberplate@gmail.com`.
- Address: `52 Purana Paltan Line, Paltan, Dhaka` | Facebook: `facebook.com/bikenumberplate`.

#### [NEW] `components/WhatsAppFloat.tsx`
- Fixed bottom-right glowing WhatsApp bubble linking to pre-composed message with order reference.

#### [NEW] `app/page.tsx`
- Compose all sections in the exact mandatory sequence with smooth-scroll anchors and responsive padding.

---

### Milestone 4: MySQL Database & LoraHost Payment Bridge

Build the persistent data layer on cPanel MySQL and implement the server-side LoraHost Payment Bridge integration.

#### [NEW] `lib/db.ts`
- MySQL connection pool via `mysql2/promise`.
- Robust parameterized query helper `query(sql, params)`.
- Reconnect and retry handlers for cPanel MySQL hosting.

#### [NEW] `scripts/migrate.sql`
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  order_number VARCHAR(32) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  shop_name VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  district VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  model ENUM('A', 'B') NOT NULL,
  reg_number_bangla VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  reg_number_english VARCHAR(80) NULL,
  quantity INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  bracket TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  unit_price INT NOT NULL,
  plate_total INT NOT NULL,
  bracket_total INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  delivery_charge INT NOT NULL,
  total INT NOT NULL,
  payment_status ENUM('pending_payment', 'verifying', 'paid', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending_payment',
  payment_method VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'lorahost_bridge',
  lora_session_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  lora_trx_id VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  trx_note VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  status ENUM('new', 'confirmed', 'printed', 'shipped', 'delivered') DEFAULT 'new',
  notes TEXT NULL,
  INDEX idx_phone (phone),
  INDEX idx_order_number (order_number),
  INDEX idx_created_at (created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  k VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY,
  v TEXT NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admins (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Initial settings seed
INSERT INTO settings (k, v) VALUES
  ('price_a', '380'),
  ('price_b', '450'),
  ('price_preorder_a', '300'),
  ('price_preorder_b', '380'),
  ('bracket_price', '80'),
  ('delivery_dhaka', '60'),
  ('delivery_outside', '120'),
  ('urgency_text', 'BRTA deadline: November 15 - order your compliant plate today'),
  ('hotline', '01632333221'),
  ('whatsapp', '01914-873925')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE k=k;
```

#### [NEW] `lib/lorahost.ts`
- **Session Creator**:
  - Sends `POST https://lorahost.lorapok.tech/api/payment-bridge/v1/sessions`.
  - Header: `Authorization: Bearer ${process.env.LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN}`.
  - JSON Payload:
    ```json
    {
      "reference": "BNP-20261101-ABCD",
      "amount": 520,
      "return_url": "https://bnp.shop/payment/return",
      "customer": {
        "name": "Customer Name",
        "phone": "017XXXXXXXX"
      }
    }
    ```
  - Handles response: retrieves `checkout_url` and `session_id`.
  - Retry logic for `409 duplicate invoice`: creates fresh reference with a distinct nonce.
- **Return HMAC Signature Verifier**:
  - Canonical alphabetized query string sorting (excluding `sig`).
  - Computes `crypto.createHmac('sha256', LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN).update(canonicalString).digest('hex')`.
  - Verifies in constant time using `crypto.timingSafeEqual`.
- **Webhook Signature Verifier**:
  - Computes HMAC SHA-256 of the raw unparsed JSON request body with `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`.
  - Compares against the `X-LoraHost-Signature` header.

#### [NEW] `app/api/order/route.ts`
- Server-side validation of all customer inputs (phone regex, quantity limits, sanitized address).
- Server-side price recalculation querying `settings` table (never trusts client price).
- Inserts order as `pending_payment`.
- Calls `createBridgeSession()` and returns `{ checkout_url, order_number }`.
- If manual payment chosen, marks as `verifying` with transaction ID and redirects to success screen.

#### [NEW] `app/payment/return/page.tsx` & `app/api/payment/webhook/route.ts`
- Return route validates HMAC signature, updates order in database, and renders `/payment/success` or `/payment/failed`.
- Webhook route parses raw body, verifies `X-LoraHost-Signature`, idempotently transitions order to `paid`, updates `lora_trx_id`, and triggers Discord alert.

---

### Milestone 5: Discord Webhook Dispatcher & Confirmation Pages

#### [NEW] `lib/discord.ts`
- Server-side notification utility:
  ```typescript
  export async function sendOrderDiscordNotification(order: OrderRecord) {
    if (!process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL) return;
    const embed = {
      title: "🚀 New Paid Order: " + order.order_number,
      color: 0xE11D2E,
      fields: [
        { name: "Customer", value: `${order.name} (${order.phone})`, inline: true },
        { name: "District", value: order.district, inline: true },
        { name: "Model", value: `Model ${order.model} (${order.model === 'A' ? '285x50mm' : '200x100mm'})`, inline: true },
        { name: "Plate Number", value: `**${order.reg_number_bangla}**`, inline: false },
        { name: "Bracket Addon", value: order.bracket ? "✅ Yes (+80 BDT)" : "❌ No", inline: true },
        { name: "Total Amount", value: `**৳ ${order.total} BDT**`, inline: true },
        { name: "Transaction ID", value: order.lora_trx_id || order.trx_note || "N/A", inline: true },
        { name: "WhatsApp Paper Check", value: `[Open WhatsApp Chat](https://wa.me/88${order.phone})`, inline: false }
      ],
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      footer: { text: "BNP | Joy & Arash Enterprise" }
    };
    await fetch(process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ embeds: [embed] })
    });
  }
  ```

#### [NEW] `app/payment/success/page.tsx` & `app/payment/failed/page.tsx`
- Success: Visual invoice slip, green checkmark animation, button to download receipt, and one-click WhatsApp button with pre-filled message: *"Hello BNP, I completed payment for Order [BNP-XXXX]. Here is the photo of my bike registration paper: [Attach Photo]"*.
- Failed: Friendly error explanation, retry payment button, and instructions to complete via manual Send Money.

---

### Milestone 6: Admin Portal & Store Settings Management

A full administrative suite to monitor orders, advance manufacturing states, and adjust prices.

#### [NEW] `lib/admin-auth.ts`
- Bcrypt verification against `admins` table.
- Issues secure, signed, HttpOnly session cookie (`bnp_admin_session`) using `jose`.
- Middleware `/middleware.ts` guarding all `/admin/*` routes except `/admin/login`.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/login/page.tsx`
- Minimalist dark aesthetic login page with email, password, and error alerts.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/orders/page.tsx`
- Real-time orders table:
  - Search by mobile number, order ID, or registration number.
  - Filter by `payment_status` (`pending_payment`, `verifying`, `paid`, `failed`) and `status` (`new`, `confirmed`, `printed`, `shipped`, `delivered`).
  - One-click status updater dropdown.
  - "Chat on WhatsApp" quick link for each customer.
  - Expandable row showing full delivery address, bracket status, and transaction references.

#### [NEW] `app/admin/settings/page.tsx`
- Key-value config editor for:
  - Model A Retail & Pre-order Price
  - Model B Retail & Pre-order Price
  - Mounting Bracket Price
  - Delivery Fees (Inside/Outside Dhaka)
  - Urgency Banner Text
  - Hotline & WhatsApp Contact Numbers

#### [NEW] `app/api/admin/orders/[id]/route.ts` & `app/api/admin/settings/route.ts`
- Authenticated endpoints supporting status updates and dynamic settings modification.

---

### Milestone 7: Optimization, Build Verification & Deployment Runbook

Final hardening, production build verification, and deployment documentation for HostNF cPanel + Vercel.

#### [NEW] `docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md`
- Step-by-step instructions for:
  1. Importing `scripts/migrate.sql` into HostNF cPanel MySQL via phpMyAdmin.
  2. Setting up environment variables in Vercel or cPanel Node.js Application Manager.
  3. Configuring LoraHost Payment Bridge partner dashboard:
     - Partner ID: `bnp`
     - Display Name: `BNP`
     - Return Hosts: `bnp.shop`, `localhost:3000`
     - Webhook URL: `https://bnp.shop/api/payment/webhook`
  4. Pointing DNS records from HostNF domain registrar to Vercel.
  5. Running the live 1 BDT end-to-end verification test.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
1. **Next.js Production Build**:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```

args.Content:
# BNP — Bike Number Plate

> **A Joy & Arash Enterprise Venture**  
> Premium Quality | Durable | Stylish  
> Official Website: [bnp.shop](https://bnp.shop)

---

## Overview

BNP (Bike Number Plate) is a modern full-stack e-commerce platform and administration portal engineered for custom, laser-cut mirror-silver stainless steel (0.8 mm, Finish No. 8) and BRTA-compliant aluminum motorcycle and scooter number plates in Bangladesh.

### Key Features

- **Sensory Interactive Plate Designer**: Real-time metallic plate visualization for Model A (Motorcycle: 285×50 mm) and Model B (Scooter: 200×100 mm).
- **Bangla Smart Transliteration Engine**: Real-time phonetic parsing that automatically converts English input (e.g. `Dhaka Metro LA 12 3456`) to valid BRTA Bangla format (`ঢাকা মেট্রো-ল-১২-৩৪৫৬`).
- **Full-Stack Order Pipeline**: Streamlined order placement with Pathao courier delivery calculation and mandatory WhatsApp registration verification.
- **LoraHost Payment Bridge Integration**: Automatic checkout session routing via PayStation (bKash, Nagad, cards) with cryptographic HMAC return and raw-body webhook signature verification.
- **Manual Payment Fallback**: Integrated bKash / Nagad Send Money verification with Transaction ID logging.
- **Discord Dispatcher**: Server-side webhook notifications delivering instant order embeds to private team channels.
- **Administrative Portal (`/admin`)**: Secure, bcrypt-authenticated dashboard for searching, filtering, and advancing order statuses (New, Confirmed, Printed, Shipped, Delivered) with direct WhatsApp customer chat links and dynamic settings management.

---

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 14+ (App Router, TypeScript, React)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons
- **Typography**: Hind Siliguri (Bangla), Sora / Space Grotesk (Headings)
- **Database**: cPanel MySQL via `mysql2` parameterized queries
- **Security**: Bcrypt password hashing, signed HTTP-only cookies, HMAC SHA-256 webhook validation
- **Deployment**: Vercel (Frontend & Serverless API) + HostNF cPanel (MySQL)

---

## Environment Variables

Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and configure your credentials:

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Canonical public URL (e.g. `https://bnp.shop`) |
| `MYSQL_HOST` | MySQL database host |
| `MYSQL_PORT` | MySQL port (default: 3306) |
| `MYSQL_USER` | MySQL database user |
| `MYSQL_PASSWORD` | MySQL database password |
| `MYSQL_DATABASE` | MySQL database name (`bnp_shop`) |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_URL` | LoraHost Payment Bridge endpoint |
| `LORA_BRIDGE_CLIENT_TOKEN` | Bearer authorization client token |
| `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN` | Secret key for return query signature verification |
| `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN` | Secret key for raw webhook signature verification |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` | Discord webhook URL for instant order alerts |
| `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` | Secret key for signed admin session cookies |
| `ADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL` | Default administrator account email |

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Install Dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

### 2. Run Database Migrations

```bash
npm run db:migrate
```

### 3. Start Local Development Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.

---

Building `lib/lorahost.ts` requires implementing a session creation function. This function will make a POST request to a specified API endpoint with a bearer token for authorization. The request body will include a reference, amount, return URL, and customer details, likely in JSON format.

The route handler needs validation for the order data. These checks include string validations for name, district, address and registration number as well as regex for phone number. Additional validations cover model type, quantity, bracket and payment method.

Building the return route to handle the redirection from the payment service. The route will validate incoming query parameters, specifically checking a cryptographic signature for data integrity. Successful signature verification triggers status updates: a 'success' status indicates the order payment status needs to be updated to 'paid'.

The endpoint `/api/payment/webhook` will handle incoming payment webhooks. It verifies the signature of the incoming request body against a header. Upon successful signature verification, the endpoint parses the JSON body and updates a payment record based on the received data. A failure to verify the signature will return a 401 error.

## 3. Key Findings & Decisions
- **cPanel MySQL with Memory Fallback**: Built `lib/db.ts` to seamlessly use MySQL pool when configured (`MYSQL_HOST`, `MYSQL_USER`, `MYSQL_PASSWORD`, `MYSQL_DATABASE`), while providing an in-memory mock store when database credentials are not present in local dev or CI. This prevents runtime crashes during static prerendering.
- **Server-Side Pricing Validation**: Total amounts are strictly recalculated server-side in `app/api/order/route.ts` based on the `settings` table/defaults; client prices are treated as display-only to prevent tampering.
- **HMAC Signatures**:
  - Return URL signature is calculated over canonical sorted query parameters excluding `sig` using `LORA_RETURN_HMAC_TOKEN`.
  - Webhook signature is calculated over the raw string body (via `req.text()`) using `LORA_WEBHOOK_HMAC_TOKEN`.
- **409 Duplicate Invoice Handling**: Handled in `lib/lorahost.ts` by generating a fresh reference with an appended retry nonce (`-R1`, `-R2`) rather than reusing `session_id`.

---

1. **ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pypdf'**:
   - *Cause*: Python environment lacked `pypdf`.
   - *Fix*: Used native `/usr/bin/pdftotext` to extract text from `BFNP_Archive_Finance_Master_Tracker_Duplicate.pdf.pdf` and `BFNP_Interactive_Dataset_Cost_and_Financial_Breakdown_Tracker.pdf.pdf`.
